executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by Bisha Hotel, not a vague visibility problem.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Bisha Hotel appears in 24 monitored scenarios where Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Outdoor Event Space at 0% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers. Softest Scenario Capture is Celebration at 20.0%. Bisha Hotel most often appears when the hotel is missing (24 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Celebration is the softest Scenario Capture at 20.0%. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. Bisha Hotel appears most often when the hotel is missing (24 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 19.0% (4 of 21 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Family-Friendly.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on the demand contexts where Bisha Hotel is consistently surfaced instead of Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Open the underlying displacement evidence for Bisha Hotel and compare attributes cited in those answers with Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
